_meta.why: AI-VEH predicts service due-dates and costs and injects them into the cash-flow forecast as scheduled outflows. It needs a bundled knowledge base of intervals and typical Indian cost ranges per vehicle class so predictions work from the first odometer reading.
_meta.what: Per vehicle class: service intervals (km and months), typical Indian cost ranges (minor units, INR paise), and consumable replacement intervals.
_meta.result: 'Service due ~Aug 20, expect INR 3,000-4,500' style alerts, adjusted by the user's own service-cost history (personal index).
changelog: 2026-07-17 — Created from SRS v1.7 §12. Cost ranges are starter estimates in INR minor units; refined by the user's personal cost index.
_meta.prediction_note: kmPerMonth = robustSlope(odometer readings, last 12 months). nextService.dueAt = min(lastService.odo + interval_km via kmPerMonth, lastService.date + interval_months). predictedCost adjusted by user's personal cost index.

alerts.mileage_drop: mileage drop > 15% vs 3-month baseline -> 'possible maintenance issue'
alerts.renewal: insurance / PUC expiry at -30 and -7 days
